name: MCX SPEAR
description:
Adopted as the new assault rifle of the Grand Federation, the winner of their next generation competition chosen to replace their standard issue carbine. It fires a high pressure 6.8x51mm round designed to improve upon 7.62x51mm NATO with better recoil control, ballistics, and penetration.

Somewhat lower damage, but makes up for it with a very high rate of fire and acceptable recoil control.

Community submitted model!
